offer.label: 01 / WHAT WE DO
offer.headline: OUR SERVICES
offer.subheader: End-to-end video production that scales your business. From strategy through production to final edit — we deliver visual storytelling built for conversion and real sales results.

corporateFilm.title: Corporate Film
corporateFilm.body: Corporate films that build trust, strengthen brand perception and support your business goals — from employer branding to investor communication. Cinematic quality without the agency mark-up.

commercialFilm.title: Commercial Video
commercialFilm.body: Ad spots and video campaigns built for conversion. From 15-second reels to full multi-platform campaigns — every format is designed around a specific goal: click, sign-up, purchase.

brandFilm.title: Brand Film
brandFilm.body: Cinematic productions that capture the essence of your brand. We build emotional connection with your audience and elevate quality perception — a brand film is an investment that works for years.

productVideos.title: Product Videos
productVideos.body: We present your solutions in a clear and engaging way. We showcase the real benefits and value of your product in a format that resonates with your audience and drives conversion.

eventReportage.title: Event Coverage
eventReportage.body: Professional video production for conferences, industry events, and corporate gatherings. Multi-camera coverage, dynamic editing, and full post-production — we deliver polished material that extends the life of your event.

instagramReels.title: Social Media Video
instagramReels.body: Short-form vertical content (9:16) for TikTok, Instagram Reels, and YouTube Shorts. One shoot day, one month of content. Build expert authority and drive organic reach across every platform.

linkedinVideo.title: LinkedIn Video
linkedinVideo.body: Professional video content that builds your position in the B2B world. Stand out with substantive content and showcase your expertise in an attractive format. We'll help you create a consistent content calendar.

caseStudies.title: Video Case Studies
caseStudies.body: We transform your client success stories into compelling video material. Build trust by showcasing the real results of working with your company. A powerful tool for strengthening the middle of your sales funnel.

expertInterviews.title: Expert Interviews
expertInterviews.body: Professional recordings of interviews and industry commentary. Build your expert position through valuable conversations with people from your industry. Leverage the power of cross-marketing.

privacy.label: Legal
privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: This document explains what personal data we collect when you use nonoise.media, why we collect it, who we share it with and what rights you have.

sections.title: Data controller
paragraphs: The controller of your personal data is Michał Jagniątkowski, trading as Michał Jagniątkowski Nonoise Media, ul. Podklasztorna 95C/4, 25-714 Kielce, Poland, tax ID (NIP) 9591756851.
For anything related to your personal data, write to contact@nonoise.media.

sections.title: What data we collect
paragraphs: We process the data you give us and the technical data needed to run the site and measure how our ads perform.
items: Contact form: your name, email address and message.
Questionnaire: your answers about the project, your name or company name and the contact method you choose, either an email address or a phone number.
Direct contact: whatever you share when you email or call us.
Technical data: IP address, browser and device type, pages visited, referring page and time of visit.
Visit source: Google ad click identifiers and campaign parameters, described in the next section.

sections.title: Google Ads and conversion measurement
paragraphs: We run Google Ads campaigns. When you arrive from an ad, the page address carries a click identifier (gclid, gbraid or wbraid) and campaign parameters (utm_source, utm_medium, utm_campaign, utm_term).

The site stores these values, together with the click time and landing page, in your browser's storage (localStorage) for 90 days. If you decline advertising cookies, they go to session storage (sessionStorage) only and are cleared when you close the browser tab.

When you send the contact form or the questionnaire, this information reaches our inbox together with your enquiry. It tells us which ad brought the enquiry and lets us later report to Google Ads which enquiries turned into work. We then send the click identifier or, when there is none, a hashed email address or phone number.

When you send a form, we also pass your email address or phone number to Google Ads for enhanced conversions. The Google tag hashes this data with SHA-256 in your browser before it is sent, so Google receives a hash, not the plain value. Google uses it to match the enquiry to the ad click.
Google tags run through Google Tag Manager, within the limits set by your cookie settings.

sections.title: Analytics and performance
items: Vercel Web Analytics measures traffic without cookies. A visitor is recognised by a hash derived from the request, valid for one day.
Vercel Speed Insights collects page load measurements (Core Web Vitals), without cookies.
If you accept analytics cookies, we also use Google Analytics to understand how visitors use the site.

sections.title: Legal bases
items: Answering your enquiry and preparing a quote: Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR (steps taken at your request before entering into a contract) and Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR (our legitimate interest in handling correspondence).
Running and securing the site, and cookieless analytics: Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR.

Non-essential cookies and similar technologies, including Google Analytics, Google Ads and enhanced conversions: your consent, Art. 6(1)(a) GDPR in connection with Art. 399 of the Polish Electronic Communications Law.
Assessing which enquiries came from ads and turned into work, and reporting this to Google Ads: Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR (our legitimate interest in measuring advertising performance).
Establishing, pursuing or defending legal claims: Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR.
after: Providing data is voluntary, but without it we cannot answer your enquiry.

sections.title: Who processes data for us
paragraphs: We use external providers who process data on our behalf:
items: Resend (Resend, Inc., USA): delivering contact form and questionnaire messages to our inbox.
Vercel (Vercel Inc., USA): hosting, server logs, Vercel Web Analytics and Speed Insights.
Google (Google Ireland Limited, Google LLC): Google Tag Manager, Google Ads and Google Analytics. For advertising, Google may act as an independent controller.
after: Data may also be disclosed to authorities entitled to it by law.

sections.title: Transfers outside the EEA
paragraphs: Resend, Vercel and Google also process data in the United States. Transfers rely on the European Commission's adequacy decision for the EU-US Data Privacy Framework or on standard contractual clauses approved by the Commission.

sections.title: How long we keep data
items: Correspondence and form submissions: for as long as needed to handle the enquiry and any resulting work, then until the limitation period for claims expires.

Click identifiers and campaign parameters in your browser: 90 days from the ad visit, or until the tab is closed if you decline advertising cookies. You can remove them sooner by clearing site data in your browser.
Data processed on the basis of consent: until you withdraw it.
Server logs and analytics data: according to the retention periods used by Vercel and Google.

sections.title: Your rights
items: access your data and receive a copy,
have it corrected,
have it erased,
restrict its processing,
data portability,
object to processing based on our legitimate interest,
withdraw consent at any time, without affecting the lawfulness of processing before withdrawal.
after: To exercise these rights, write to contact@nonoise.media.
You also have the right to lodge a complaint with the Polish supervisory authority, the President of the Personal Data Protection Office (PUODO, ul. Stawki 2, 00-193 Warszawa, uodo.gov.pl).
We do not make decisions about you based solely on automated processing that produce legal effects.

sections.title: Cookies
paragraphs: The site uses cookies and similar technologies (localStorage, sessionStorage). Those needed for the site to work are always on; analytics and advertising ones only after you consent in the cookie banner.
A detailed list of cookies, their providers and retention periods is available under “Cookie settings” in the site footer. There you can also change or withdraw consent at any time.

sections.title: Changes to this policy
paragraphs: We may update this policy when the tools we use or the law change. The current version is always on this page, and the date at the top shows the latest change.
